AudioFlipper 1.4 shows your webcam's name on the taskbar widget, and lets you rename it.

## New

- **Webcam name on the widget**: the webcam section shows the camera icon (struck through while the
  webcam is off), then the webcam's name over **On** or **Off**, like the output and input sections.
- **Rename a webcam**: Windows has no way to rename a webcam, so **Webcam → Rename…** in the
  right-click menu gives it a name in AudioFlipper, shown on the widget and in the menu. Leave the
  name empty to go back to the webcam's own name. Each webcam keeps the name you give it.

## Installing or updating

Download **AudioFlipper.exe** below. If you're updating, exit the running copy (right-click the
widget → **Exit**) and replace your old AudioFlipper.exe with the new one. Your settings are kept.
It's not code-signed, so Windows may show "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info → Run
anyway**.
